sections.corporate:
The section captures all mentions of the Transport Accident Commission aka TAC, its spokespeople, campaigns and Victoria’s TAC Minister.

Include coverage on the following:

Any mention of the TAC, TAC spokespeople, TAC campaigns
Any mention of Tracey Slatter, CEO, TAC
Any mention of Joe Calafiore, former CEO of TAC
Any mention of Samantha Cockfield, Head of Road Safety at TAC
Any mention of Anne Harris, TAC Road Safety Director 
Any mention of Ben Carrol in relation to his role as Minister for TAC
Mentions of the AlphV ransomware attack/hack and law firm HWL Ebsworth in relation to the TAC
Mentions of the Melbourne Rebels Super Rugby club trading insolvent if it doesn’t mention the TAC

Do not include coverage of the following:
Mentions of Ben Carrol in relation to his role as Deputy Premier, Minister for Education, Minister for Worksafe, Minister for Medical Research → Mentions of Ben Carrol must be in relation to his role as Minister for TAC
Mentions of the AlphV ransomware attack/hack and law firm HWL Ebsworth not related to the TAC → HWL Ebsworth articles must include a TAC mention
Mentions of the Melbourne Rebels Super Rugby club trading insolvent that reference the TAC → Melbourne Rebels Super Rugby club content needs to have no TAC mention
sections.victorian_government:
The section captures coverage of the Victorian Government, its departments and its agencies in relation to roads, road trauma, road safety and safe driving programs.

Include coverage on the following:

Any mention of Victorian Government policy and announcements in relation to roads, road trauma, road safety, safe driving programs.
Any mention of  Victoria's Department of Transport and Planning in relation to roads, road trauma, road safety, safe driving programs.
Any mention of Minister for Roads and Road Safety Ros Spence in relation to roads and road safety
Any mention of Public Transport Minister Gabrielle Leigh Williams in relation to roads and road safety
Major coverage of Minister Ben Carroll that doesn’t also mention TAC, even it’s not related to workplace and road safety
Community and council campaigns, discussion and issues around the condition of roads, footpaths and bikelanes. Include any mention of calls for safety upgrades
Any mention of legislation around ebikes/escooters in Victoria.
Do not include coverage of the following:
Any mention of the TAC  → Redirect to Corporate
Coverage of Minister Ben Carroll in relation to his role as Minister for TAC → Redirect to Corporate
Coverage of federal governments with no Victorian Government angle → Redirect to Road Safety
Coverage focused on interstate governments/interstate issues → Items must include a Victorian Government angle
Coverage focusing on interstate issues → Coverage must focus on Victoria and/or include a Victorian Government mention 
Coverage of road safety education with no Victorian Government angle → Redirect to Road Safety
sections.road_safety:
This section captures general mentions about road safety in Victoria, including police blitzes on drink-driving or speeding, road safety research and road safety education.

Include coverage on the following:

Any mention of police blitzes/police operations on Victorian roads.
Any mention of road safety/trauma research in Victoria or nationally.
Any mention of the Monash University Accident Research Centre.
Any mention of infrastructure improvements to benefit road safety.
Any mention of road safety education, including local schools learning about road safety or bike education .
Any coverage of people sharing their lived experience of road trauma in Victoria.
Any coverage of pedestrian safety on Victorian roads.
Any mention of bike/motorbike/ebike/escooter safety on Victorian roads.
Court cases involving drunk/drug driving, speeding or dangerous driving that does not result in a car accident

Do not include coverage of the following:
Any mention of the TAC  → Redirect to Corporate
Coverage focused on interstate governments/interstate issues → Items must include a national or Victorian angle
Any mention of the Victorian Government, its agencies or departments in relation to road safety → Redirect to Victorian Government
Items focused on specific accidents/car crashes → Redirect to Accidents
Items focused on court cases following specific car accidents/crashes/injuries on Victorian roads → Redirect to Accidents
sections.accidents:
This section captures coverage related to accidents and injuries occurring on Victorian roads.

Include coverage on the following:

Any mention of car crashes on Victorian roads.
Any mention of injuries occurring on Victorian roads.
Court cases following accidents on Victorian roads.

Do not include coverage of the following:
Any mention of the TAC  → Redirect to Corporate
Coverage focused on interstate accidents/crashes/injuries → Items must be focused on an event in Victoria
Any mention of the Victorian Government, its agencies or departments in relation to road safety → Redirect to Victorian Government
Road safety issues with no mention of specific car crashes/accidents/injuries on Victorian roads → Redirect to Road Safety
Court cases involving speeding, drunk-driving, drug driving or dangerous driving with no mention of specific crashes/accidents/injuries on Victorian roads → Redirect to Road Safety
sections.social_insurance:
This section captures major national or Victorian coverage related to the NDIS or Worksafe.

Include coverage on the following:

Coverage of disability management or stories about people with a disability.
Major announcements/coverage of the NDIS and WorkSafe.

Do not include coverage of the following:
Any mention of the TAC  → Redirect to Corporate
Coverage focused on interstate NDIS providers → Coverage should focus on Victorian providers or federal NDIS policy
Advertising features for NDIS providers → These should be excluded from the briefing as they are not news items
